title: Fleet Vehicle Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Fleet Vehicle Service: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Fleet Vehicle Inspection Checklist covers fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision. The fleet maintenance coordinator records Fleet Vehicle Service criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Fleet Vehicle Inspection Checklist keeps Fleet Vehicle Service exceptions visible until the fleet maintenance coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Fleet Vehicle Inspection Checklist at fleet yard, service facility, operating route, and vehicle assignment point. Document fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision identity before Fleet Vehicle Service begins. Compare fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision findings with stated Fleet Vehicle Service criteria; route unresolved Fleet Vehicle Service issues to qualified fleet maintenance reviewer. For Fleet Vehicle Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Fleet Vehicle Service. Ask qualified fleet maintenance reviewer to review Fleet Vehicle Service conditions beyond the fleet maintenance coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Fleet Vehicle Service, identify responsible parties, fleet yard, service facility, operating route, and vehicle assignment point, and the linked fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision source.

fields.label: Fleet unit, work order, and department
VIN, plate, mileage, engine hours, and assignment

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Fleet Vehicle Service facts for fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

items: Parts, labor, downtime, and vendor status

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Use observed Fleet Vehicle Service evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Fleet Maintenance Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Safety defect or overdue critical service
Repair exceeds authority or downtime commitment
blocks.guidance: Pause Fleet Vehicle Service when safety, maintenance, repeat-defect, authorization, or return-to-service concern remains unresolved. Retain the available Fleet Vehicle Service proof and route unresolved fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision scope to fleet maintenance coordinator.
